chart_type.purpose: The category chart type to render (a 2D column/bar family type).

enum_descriptions.CLUSTERED_COLUMN: Vertical columns grouped side by side per category.
enum_descriptions.STACKED_COLUMN: Vertical columns stacked to show cumulative totals per category.
enum_descriptions.PERCENTS_STACKED_COLUMN: Vertical columns stacked to 100% to show each series' share per category.
enum_descriptions.CLUSTERED_BAR: Horizontal bars grouped side by side per category.
enum_descriptions.STACKED_BAR: Horizontal bars stacked to show cumulative totals per category.
enum_descriptions.PERCENTS_STACKED_BAR: Horizontal bars stacked to 100% to show each series' share per category.

category_mode.purpose: Whether the category labels are fixed (reuse the provided categories exactly) or must be generated.

enum_descriptions.fixed: Category labels are provided in this context and must be reused exactly, in order.
enum_descriptions.ai_generated: Category labels are generated within the category count boundaries.

categories.purpose: When category_mode is fixed, the exact category labels to reuse, in order.

min_categories.purpose: Lower boundary on the number of categories the chart may have.

max_categories.purpose: Upper boundary on the number of categories the chart may have.

target_categories.purpose: Intended number of categories to aim for, within the min/max boundaries.

category_instruction.purpose: Optional guidance for generating the category labels.

series_mode.purpose: Whether the series names are fixed (reuse the provided names exactly) or must be generated.

enum_descriptions.fixed: Series names are provided in this context and must be reused exactly, in order.
enum_descriptions.ai_generated: Series names are generated within the series count boundaries.

series_names.purpose: When series_mode is fixed, the exact series names to reuse, in order.

min_series.purpose: Lower boundary on the number of data series.

max_series.purpose: Upper boundary on the number of data series.

target_series.purpose: Intended number of data series to aim for, within the min/max boundaries.

series_instruction.purpose: Optional guidance for generating the series names.

value_type.purpose: Data type of the series values; only numeric values are supported.

value_unit.purpose: Optional unit describing the series values (for example "%" or "USD").

allow_negative_values.purpose: Whether the generated series values may be negative.

allow_decimal_values.purpose: Whether the generated series values may be non-integer (decimal).

expected_content_schema.description: Expected AI output for a category chart component. Provide one or more data series; each series carries a numeric value per category, in category order. The chart type, category labels, series names, counts, and value formatting are defined by the component's flat tag_context (chart_type, category_mode, series_mode, categories, series_names, the count boundaries/targets, and value formatting): when category_mode or series_mode is fixed the labels or names come from that context, and when ai_generated they are generated here.

categories.description: Category labels, in order. Provide these only when tag_context.category_mode is ai_generated; for fixed categories the labels come from tag_context.categories and must not be repeated here.

series.description: One or more data series to plot. Each series carries a numeric value per category, in the same order as the categories.

name.description: Series name. Provide it only when tag_context.series_mode is ai_generated; for fixed series the names come from tag_context.series_names.

values.description: Numeric values for this series, one per category, in category order.
